facts.fact: Eswatini Positive News reports the Macetjeni iHub in the Lubombo Region was officially launched on 6 August 2026 as the second iHub after Piggs Peak, run by a competitively selected young entrepreneur, with a pilot that trained over 100 people and incubation support described as something it will offer.

SWZ.note: No digital-skills training for civil servants is stated.

facts.fact: The Minister of Commerce, Industry and Trade launched the Macetjeni iHub on 6 August 2026, set up by SEDCO with ESCCOM and UNDP, to give beneficiaries training in computer literacy, Microsoft Office, AI and digital marketing.
More than 100 participants completed computer literacy, Microsoft Office and AI training in the Macetjeni iHub pilot phase before the official launch.
